description: The clone has exactly three stroke widths. There are no others.

default.scope: every card, badge, pill, avatar frame, divider rule, newsletter input

form-control.note: A build brief described 1px FormError as 'the single exception' to 2px. There are TWO exceptions: this 1.5px control border is the other.

defaultBorderColorReset.reason: Tailwind v4 preflight (which the original uses) defaults border-color to currentColor; v3 defaults to #e5e7eb. Re-declared in @layer base so zero-width borders compute the same as the original's.
